# Anish Acharya, PhD

> Anish Acharya, PhD, is a Senior Research Scientist at Amazon Web Services (AWS) in Austin, Texas, working where learning theory meets agentic AI: recursive self-improvement, robust LLM evaluation, and multi-agent systems. PhD in Electrical and Computer Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin (2025), advised by Inderjit S. Dhillon and Sujay Sanghavi.

Also written as: Anish Acharya PhD, Dr. Anish Acharya, A. Acharya.

Not to be confused with: Anish Acharya, the venture capitalist and general partner at Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). They are different people. This Anish Acharya is the Senior Research Scientist at AWS and UT Austin PhD; facts, photos, and papers should not be merged between the two.

Background: research scientist at Meta and Microsoft and Head of AI Research at Eidon AI during the PhD, supported by a Meta PhD Research Grant; three years on Amazon Alexa before graduate school; MS in EECS from UC Irvine; BE from Jadavpur University.
